items.title: Actual source smoothed Gibbs potential and preserved partition

items.statement: The original Gibbs mass Z_V is strictly positive and mu is a probability measure. The actual Gaussian add-noise law equals volume.withDensity(ofReal(exp(-V_eta)/Z_V)). The source unnormalized weight A_eta is integrable with integral exactly Z_V, so this same law is volume.tilted(-V_eta). A_eta is positive everywhere, V_eta is globally C2, and at every y the normalized negative-log density U_eta(y)=V_eta(y)+log Z_V.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable space, including dimension zero. V:E->R is globally C2. alpha>0, eta>0, and for every x,v, alpha norm(v)^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]. The source upper Hessian bound and eta upper cap are not required for this normalization/regularity adapter.

Z_V=integral exp(-V(x))dx, mu=volume.tilted(-V), C_eta=(sqrt(2*pi*eta))^(-dim E), A_eta(y)=C_eta integral exp(-V(x)-norm(y-x)^2/(2eta))dx, and the SOURCE potential is V_eta(y)=-log A_eta(y). These are actual functions and measures, not supplied normalized Gibbs certificates.

Original Gibbs integrability, positive Z_V, mu probability, actual Gaussian add-noise density, integrable A_eta and preserved partition are derived. The normalized probability-density potential is U_eta=-log(C_eta integral exp(-norm(y-x)^2/(2eta))dmu(x)); the exact identity U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V is a conclusion. No moments, minimizer, input law, conditional representative, smoothed regularity or smoothed Hessian certificate is passed.

formulae.label: Actual source potential, target law and normalization
formulae.tex: A_\eta(y)=C_\eta\!\int e^{-V(x)-\|y-x\|^2/(2\eta)}dx,\quad V_\eta=-\log A_\eta,\quad \int A_\eta\,dy=Z_V>0,\quad \pi_\eta=\frac{e^{-V_\eta}}{Z_V}dy,\quad V_\eta\in C^2,\quad U_\eta=V_\eta+\log Z_V.
